pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the track considered as the one placed later in the playlist for this directed pair. The pair's energy value is gained when the 'preceding_track_id' is placed before this track in the playlist.

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The numeric energy reward (positive or negative) obtained if the preceding_track_id is played before the following_track_id in the playlist. The playlist's total score is the sum of these values for every ordered pair of distinct tracks.

pair_item_fields.name: weight

pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the painting considered as the earlier work in a paired comparison — this painting would be shown before the paired painting in the route.

global_fields.scenario_description: The list of unique identifiers or short labels for every tutorial step to be ordered. Each identifier corresponds to one step that must appear once in the final sequence.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the step considered as placed earlier than another in a pair. When this step is ordered before the 'following_step_id', the pair's numeric benefit applies.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the step considered as placed later than another in a pair. Used together with 'preceding_step_id' to evaluate the pairwise benefit if the preceding step comes earlier in the workflow.

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The numeric benefit (positive or negative) representing how much learner performance or comprehension improves when the 'preceding_step_id' is taught before the 'following_step_id'. The solver sums these values for every pair that is ordered consistently with the final sequence to form the objective to maximize.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of bottles that must appear in the tasting flight (every wine appears exactly once).

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The list of identifiers for each wine (names or codes) that will be ordered into the single tasting progression.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the wine that would be tasted before another in the sequence for this pairwise comparison.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the wine that would be tasted after the earlier wine in this pairwise comparison.

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The numeric benefit (how much the palate is improved) gained if the earlier_wine_id is tasted before the later_wine_id; these values are summed across all ordered pairs to evaluate a full flight.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of distinct study topics that must be placed into one complete study sequence; every topic must appear exactly once.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: An ordered list of identifiers (names or IDs) for each study topic to be scheduled so the solver knows which items to permute.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the topic that would appear earlier in the study sequence for this directed pair (the potential predecessor). If this topic is placed before the paired topic, the listed reinforcement_score applies.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the topic that would appear later in the study sequence for this directed pair (the potential successor). The benefit number applies when the preceding_topic_id is scheduled before this topic.

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: A numeric score representing the retention benefit gained if the preceding_topic_id is scheduled before the following_topic_id. The objective is to maximize the sum of these scores across all ordered pairs that occur in the final sequence.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of postcards to hang on the feature wall; every postcard must appear exactly once in the left-to-right sequence.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers (IDs or labels) for each postcard to be placed; these IDs are referenced by the pairwise harmony entries to evaluate different left-to-right orders.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the postcard that would be placed to the left of another postcard in the row; this is the 'from' card in a directed harmony pair.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the postcard that would be placed to the right of the 'preceding_postcard_id' in the row; this is the 'to' card in a directed harmony pair.

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric charm reward (positive or negative) added to the gallery's total if the postcard named by 'from_id' (preceding_postcard_id) appears somewhere left of the postcard named by 'to_id' (following_postcard_id) in the final left-to-right arrangement.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of fragrance strips that must appear exactly once in the tasting sequence — the count of all strips to be ordered.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: A list of identifiers (names or IDs) for every fragrance strip to be included in the single tasting lineup; each identifier refers to one unique strip.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the strip that would appear earlier in the tasting order for this pair; used to specify which strip is placed before another.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the strip that would appear later in the tasting order for this pair; used together with preceding_strip to define a directed pair.

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The numerical benefit (olfactory progression score) gained if preceding_strip is placed before following_strip in the tasting sequence; these pairwise values are summed over all earlier-later pairs to produce the total score to maximize.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of distinct morning preparation tasks that must be arranged into a single sequence (each task appears exactly once).

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers (names or short IDs) for every preparation task to be ordered in the morning routine.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the task that comes earlier in a pairwise transition (the task that hands the baton to the next).

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the task that comes later in the pairwise transition (the task that receives the baton).

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Smoothness score gained when the preceding_task_id is performed immediately before the following_task_id; used to compute the total routine quality.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of presenters that must be scheduled into the single, complete presentation sequence. This is an integer count of distinct speakers (every presenter appears exactly once).

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: An ordered list of all presenter identifiers (names or IDs). Each identifier corresponds to one speaker who must occupy exactly one slot in the final schedule.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the presenter who, if scheduled before another presenter, would contribute the listed engagement gain. This is the ‘first’ element of a directed pair (the potential predecessor in the sequence).

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the presenter who would follow the preceding presenter in a pair. The engagement gain applies when the presenter named by preceding_presenter_id is scheduled before this presenter.

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The numeric audience-engagement gain added to the event score if the preceding_presenter_id is placed earlier in the schedule than the succeeding_presenter_id. Gains can be positive, negative, or zero; the total schedule score is the sum of these gains for every ordered pair where the earlier presenter appears before the later one.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of comic panels to arrange into a single reading order — how many panels are in the pile that must each appear exactly once.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The list of all panel identifiers (unique IDs or labels for each comic panel). Every identifier here corresponds to one panel that must be placed somewhere in the final sequence.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the panel that would appear earlier in the reading order for this ordered pair — i.e., the candidate 'first' panel of the pair. If this panel is placed before the other, the listed benefit applies.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the panel that would appear later in the reading order for this ordered pair — i.e., the candidate 'second' panel of the pair. Combined with panel_before_id, it defines a directional preference.

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The numeric payoff (positive or negative) earned when panel_before_id is placed before panel_after_id in the final sequence. The overall quality of an ordering is the sum of these benefits for every ordered pair where the earlier panel precedes the later one.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of mise en place items (individual ingredients or prep items) that must be arranged in one continuous line; every ingredient must appear exactly once and this number equals the count of those items.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: List of all ingredient identifiers (names or labels) that make up the mise en place; each identifier corresponds to one item that must be placed in the final sequence.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the ingredient considered as placed earlier in the line (the source of a directed pair). When this item appears before another, the associated bonus (weight) applies.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the ingredient considered as placed later in the line (the target of a directed pair). The bonus applies when the preceding_ingredient is placed before this item.

pair_item_fields.name: weight
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric reward (efficiency bonus) awarded if the preceding_ingredient is positioned before the following_ingredient in the final layout; the solver sums these scores for all ordered pairs to compute overall prep efficiency.
